# cairn admin connector

cairn.admin.v1 connector lifecycle verbs

```text
cairn.admin.v1 connector lifecycle verbs

Usage: cairn admin connector [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  enable    Mark a connector enabled (gates the poll loop)

  backfill  Spawn a bounded backfill (spawner adapter not yet wired)
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:

  -h, --help                  Print help
```
